protocol: no further model/feature/threshold changes after this freeze; additional CMedQA queries are fixed transfer evaluation only
additional_queries: At most 256 lowest SHA256(rfc01-cmedqa-unused|qid) plain answerable queries in the existing 20k corpus, excluding prior 512 IDs and near-duplicates (NFKC alphanumeric bigram Jaccard>=.8) of all observed query sets; report actual count, do not refill based on scores
cost_sample: 48 lowest SHA256(rfc01-http|qid) dev IDs; 3 repeats, 5 variants in deterministic shuffled order; k=100; warm up 3 per variant; paired repeated queries
limitation: same observed 20k corpus; answerability-conditioned restricted qrels; not a new corpus, official full benchmark, or final team-approved holdout
